verdict: Cost per lead fell sharply, but leads need follow-up to become cases.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 47 leads at $36.51 cost per lead — a 45% drop in cost per lead week-over-week alongside a 31% rise in leads, both strong directional signals. That said, a five-day pause in ad spend mid-period interrupted campaign momentum, so the efficiency gain is real but not yet at full stride. The more pressing issue is that leads arriving are not being followed into the pipeline: automated SMS follow-up and call access are not yet active, meaning new contacts are receiving no outreach after they come in. Getting that follow-up sequence live is the immediate priority, and the next period should reflect both steadier ad delivery and leads that are actively worked.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, up 31% from the prior week
cost per lead this period, down 45% week-over-week
total actions on your Google Business Profile this period, including 61 calls

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but receiving no automated follow-up, leaving incoming contacts without outreach.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and call access are being activated now so every new lead enters an immediate follow-up sequence.
